metaDescription: Order custom copper buttons, stickers, and patches for a vintage look. Perfect for branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Copper adds a warm, metallic finish that stands out from standard plastic or enamel options. These custom copper buttons, stickers, and patches develop a natural patina over time, giving your branded merchandise a unique, vintage character. Ideal for trade shows, retail tags, or employee recognition, copper items pair well with leather or dark fabrics. Decorate with screen printing or embossing for a tactile logo that customers remember.
heroAltText: A stack of custom copper buttons and stickers with embossed logos, showing metallic sheen and patina.
